highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Whether you’re interested in innovative programmes or research-driven courses, Dallas Baptist University (DBU) is a good choice. It’s a private institution located in Dallas, Texas, offering over 50 undergraduate and postgraduate programmes in a range of fields, including Business, Education, Health Sciences, Liberal Arts, and the Arts.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: With over 40 student organisations and clubs, you’ll always be active. You’ll also find intramural sports and social events that enhance your college experience.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
DBU Dallas offers a variety of on-campus housing options, including residence halls, apartments, townhomes, and more. Additionally, if you're looking for off-campus housing, DBU has resources available to help you find safe, convenient, and affordable options in the Dallas area.

You can also download our app and check out the Stays feature for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
DBU’s Mabee Learning Centre offers a wide range of academic resources to support your studies. Whether you need textbooks, journals, or online resources, the library is your go-to place for research.

Sports
The university has various sports facilities, including a fitness centre, tennis courts, and recreational fields. You can join intramural sports or cheer for DBU’s NCAA Division II teams. The campus also has a Student Wellness Centre, ensuring that you can stay active and healthy.

Laboratory
If you choose science, health, and engineering fields, DBU offers state-of-the-art laboratories and research equipment to help you with hands-on learning and research.

Cafeteria
DBU’s dining services provide a variety of meal plans to suit your tastes and dietary needs. You can have fresh food and beverages at many spots on the campus, including the Crowley Dining Hall, the Patriot Cafe, the Daily Bread Bistro, and more.
